# Physical-growth V2: three complete exact non-target controls

All three bodies below have uniform volume density at their own exact centroid, true simplicial hulls, additionalweak000 and primitivezero000. None is110. Literal input clouds contain83rows; true V must not be confused with input count. Exact geometry is completely recoverable from the JSON blocks below without a sandbox or optimizer replay.

## Exact dependency, producing method, commands, observed receipts
Explicit required verifier dependency: [internal-source-reference] (JB_C168_OWN211_EXACT_RECOVERY_V1.md13684B,SHA2b1c5045a6bac634a6858e76e723cf3820fe4185a0ef3253bb1a845d696b84e2) contains the complete standard-library exact_poly.py6134B SHA898f77989193886996d6f2dc121ccdfdf611b8a9ac52fd3207557eac6a69c0c4. Attach that whole material with this one to a fresh worker. All true maximal facets of these inputs are triangular; the verifier explicitly rejects nonsimplicial cases, enumerates every supporting triple with exact integers and computes filled-volume centroid, all strict/closed weak S/U/H and complete rational P/Q landscapes. It is not merely Euler or a tolerance census.

Complete producing method is [internal-source-reference] JOINT_GROWTH_V2_COMPLETE_METHODS.md,11726B,SHAd161d54b414582e206e2bef75e6578baa4b2b768ff64cabf31dd5add87f80e5c. Executed relative and log searches each start independently from literal JB_REF48_TRUE53_G8.json:
```
python joint_growth_v2.py JB_REF48_TRUE53_G8.json G2_REL --caps 30 --capheight .01 --order balanced --steps 1500 --lr .0008 --energy relative --pweight 3 --record 100 --digits 8
python joint_growth_v2.py JB_REF48_TRUE53_G8.json G2_LOG --caps 30 --capheight .01 --order balanced --steps 1500 --lr .0008 --energy log --pweight 3 --record 100 --digits 8
```
Other parameters are defaults epsilon1e-16,seed0,noise0, gradientclip10 and gauge1e-4. Remove old redundant input points before actual-center/RMS normalization; add30 real outward caps. Own centroid,hull and both forests/roots/witnesses are rebuilt every step. The two objective values are not directly comparable because energy differs. Saved class211 checkpoint is selected only every100iterations, whereas BEST is updated everyiteration.

Write each JSON block exactly with LF final newline, then execute:
```
python exact_poly.py G2_REL_S2U1_G8.json
python exact_poly.py G2_REL_BEST_G8.json
python exact_poly.py G2_LOG_BEST_G8.json
```
